title: All my clients wanted a carousel, now it's an AI chatbot
summary: A web developer/agency owner's perspective on how client demands have shifted from requesting traditional website carousels (sliding banner components) to demanding AI chatbots, reflecting the broader AI hype cycle and changing client expectations in web development.
problem_solved: Illustrates the industry trend shift from traditional web UI components (carousels) to AI-powered interactive elements as client priorities change.
why_valuable: Provides real-world insight into how AI trends are reshaping client expectations for web projects, useful for developers and agencies navigating the current market.
